newsitem.title: USA: Family Golf Centers buys three facilities.
newsitem.headline: Family Golf Centers buys three facilities.

text.p: Family Golf Centers Inc said Tuesday it had acquired three golf facilities and had been awarded contracts to build three golf centers, which would bring to 51 the number of properties it owns, operates or has under construction.

The three facilities acquired are Supersports Family Fun Park in Carver, Mass.; Palm Royale Golf Course in Palm Desert, Calif., and Southampton Golf Center in Philadelphia, the company said in a news release. Terms were not disclosed.
The construction contracts were for a golf center in Los Angeles and two in New York City.
Family Golf also said it had completed the previously announced acquisition of golf facilities in Tempe, Ariz., and San Bruno and Milpitas, Calif.
